title: Shotcut: free Adobe Premiere alternative
caption:
Adobe Premiere costs $22.99/month to edit videos. Shotcut does it for free 🎬

✅ Multitrack timeline with thumbnails and waveforms
✅ Color wheels, chroma key, blur and 100+ video filters
✅ Keyframes for filter settings, plus audio and video fades
✅ Edits files directly with no import step, up to 4K

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Shotcut is a capable editor but has its own look, so expect a learning curve coming from Premiere. Adobe's $22.99/month is the Premiere-only plan, billed monthly on an annual commitment
